prompt: If one wanted to create a data quality application that runs on data stored in HDFS, what would be a good way to approach this? Specifically, assuming the user has defined data quality rules, what would be a good way to evaluate them (specifically in terms of performance)?
response: To evaluate data quality rules performance on HDFS data, you can directly apply the rules to the entire dataset using a MapReduce job. This approach ensures that all data is checked against the rules, and it leverages Hadoop's distributed processing power. While it may seem straightforward, this method is effective for ensuring comprehensive data quality assessment without the need for sampling.
